T: Keep the windows shut. Keep the crab coming.
D: A San Francisco socialite follows a man to a seaside town where the birds start attacking.
P: Serve the crab when Melanie sits down at the restaurant in Bodega Bay.
S: the seaside town north of San Francisco
Crab meat folded with a little mayo, lemon, chives and a pinch of cayenne, piled on toasted sourdough rubbed with garlic.
the children's birthday party on the hill

Poached chicken folded with mayo, celery, toasted walnuts, grapes and tarragon, in soft white bread cut into party triangles. Poach 2 chicken breasts in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, cool and shred finely. Mix with 5 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 finely diced celery sticks, 40g chopped toasted walnuts, a handful of halved green grapes, 1 tbsp chopped tarragon, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper. Butter 12 slices of soft white bread and fill 6 sandwiches. Trim the crusts and cut each into 4 triangles.
the pair of lovebirds Melanie brings in a cage
Little pastry nests of filo baked at 180C until crisp, filled with whipped goat's cheese, a few peas and a mint leaf, two to a plate.
M: the city Melanie drives out from
Onion, fennel and garlic cooked in olive oil, tomato, white wine and fish stock simmered 20 minutes, mussels, clams, prawns and white fish added in turns. Sourdough.
Lydia's roast chicken with sage stuffing

Golden roast chicken filled with a sage, onion and bread stuffing, with roast potatoes, glazed carrots and a pan gravy made from the drippings. Heat the oven to 200C. Soften 1 diced onion in 40g butter, then mix with 150g fresh breadcrumbs, chopped sage, 1 egg, salt and pepper. Stuff a 1.8kg chicken, rub with butter and salt and roast with 1kg halved potatoes tossed in oil for 1 hour 20 minutes. Glaze 500g sliced carrots in a pan with butter, 1 tbsp honey and a splash of water. Rest the chicken 15 minutes, stir 1 tbsp flour and 250ml stock into the tray for gravy.
W: Meringue piped into little nests, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, filled with lemon curd and topped with speckled chocolate eggs.
K: Hot coffee with brown sugar and 30ml Irish whiskey, lightly whipped cream floated on top.

s.note: the seaside town north of San Francisco
s.how: Fold 250g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, chopped chives and a pinch of cayenne. Toast 8 small slices of sourdough and rub with a cut garlic clove. Pile the crab on top and serve straight away.

s.note: the pair of lovebirds Melanie brings in a cage
s.how: Cut 4 sheets filo into squares, brush with 40g melted butter and press into a mini muffin tin in layers. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp. Fill with 120g whipped goat's cheese, a few blanched peas and a mint leaf. Serve two to a plate.

m.note: the city Melanie drives out from
m.how: Soften an onion, a fennel bulb and 3 garlic cloves in oil. Add a tin of tomatoes, 250ml white wine and 500ml fish stock and simmer 20 minutes. Add 500g mussels and 500g clams, then 300g prawns and 300g snapper. Serve with sourdough.

w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites and 180g sugar over simmering water until hot, then beat to stiff peaks. Pipe 8 small nests and bake at 100C for 90 minutes. Cool, fill with lemon curd and top each with three speckled chocolate eggs.

d.how: Brew 60g coffee with 1L water. For each glass, stir 2 tsp brown sugar into 150ml hot coffee with 30ml Irish whiskey. Pour 200ml lightly whipped cream over the back of a spoon so it floats.
